theory.intro: An **annuity** is a sequence of equal, regular payments into or out of an investment or loan, including regular withdrawals. A period-by-period table tracks the interest earned on the opening balance and the regular payment added or subtracted at the end.
facts: Interest for each period is calculated on the **opening balance**: $I = \text{Opening Balance} \times r$, where $r$ is the decimal interest rate per payment/compounding period.
For an investment annuity, the payment is **added** at the end: $\text{Closing} = \text{Opening} + I + \text{Payment}$.
For a reducing-balance loan, interest is added and the repayment is **subtracted**: $\text{Closing} = \text{Opening} + I - \text{Payment}$.
The closing balance of one period becomes the **opening balance** of the next period.
An investment recurrence relation is $V_{n} = V_{n-1}(1 + r) + D$, where $V_{0}$ is the initial balance and is zero only when no initial lump sum is invested.
A loan recurrence relation is $V_{n} = V_{n-1}(1 + r) - D$, where $V_{0}$ is the initial loan principal.
steps: Calculate interest on the opening balance for the period using $I = \text{Opening} \times r$.
Add the calculated interest to the opening balance, then add the regular deposit (for savings) or subtract the repayment (for a loan).
Calculate the closing balance and carry it forward as the next period's opening balance.

workedExamples.question_text:
A savings account starts with $\$0$. Equal deposits of $\$800$ are made at the end of each year, after interest is added. The annual interest rate is fixed.

Use Year $2$ to find the annual interest rate, then complete the table for Years $3$ and $4$. Calculate the total interest earned over the four years.

All balances and interest amounts are in dollars.

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Year}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Deposit}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&0&0&800&800\\2&800&40&800&1640\\3&1640&\cdots&800&\cdots\\4&\cdots&\cdots&800&\cdots\\\hline\end{array}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
Equal annual deposits make this a savings annuity. Interest is calculated on the opening balance before the deposit is added.

$\begin{align*}r&=\frac{40}{800}\\&=0.05=5\%\end{align*}$

For Year $3$:

$\begin{align*}I_3&=1640\times0.05\\&=\$82\\\text{Closing}_3&=1640+82+800\\&=\$2522\end{align*}$

The closing balance becomes the next year's opening balance.

$\begin{align*}I_4&=2522\times0.05\\&=\$126.10\\\text{Closing}_4&=2522+126.10+800\\&=\$3448.10\end{align*}$

The completed table, in dollars, is:

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Year}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Deposit}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&0&0&800&800\\2&800&40&800&1640\\3&1640&82&800&2522\\4&2522&126.10&800&3448.10\\\hline\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Total deposits}&=4\times800\\&=\$3200\\\text{Total interest}&=3448.10-3200\\&=\$248.10\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text:
A reducing-balance loan starts at $\$6000$. Interest is charged at $12\%$ p.a. compounded monthly. Repayments of $\$500$ are made at the end of each month, after interest is charged.

Complete the table for the first three months and calculate the total interest charged. Give monetary answers to the nearest cent, retaining full precision until rounding each requested result.

All amounts in the table are in dollars.

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Month}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Repayment}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&6000&\cdots&500&\cdots\\2&\cdots&\cdots&500&\cdots\\3&\cdots&\cdots&500&\cdots\\\hline\end{array}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
The monthly interest rate is $12\%\div12=1\%$. Add interest to the opening balance, then subtract the repayment.

$\begin{align*}I_1&=6000\times0.01=60\\\text{Closing}_1&=6000+60-500=5560\\I_2&=5560\times0.01=55.60\\\text{Closing}_2&=5560+55.60-500=5115.60\\I_3&=5115.60\times0.01=51.156\\\text{Closing}_3&=5115.60+51.156-500=4666.756\end{align*}$

The completed table, in dollars, is:

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Month}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Repayment}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&6000.00&60.00&500.00&5560.00\\2&5560.00&55.60&500.00&5115.60\\3&5115.60&51.16&500.00&4666.76\\\hline\end{array}$

Repayments cover both the reduction in principal and the interest charged.

$\begin{align*}\text{Principal reduction}&=6000-4666.756\\&=1333.244\\\text{Total repayments}&=3\times500=1500\\\text{Total interest}&=1500-1333.244\\&=166.756\\&\approx\$166.76\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text:
Maya starts a savings account with no initial investment. She deposits $\$900$ at the end of each half-year. Interest is paid at $4\%$ p.a. compounded half-yearly.

Write a recurrence relation, including the starting value, and determine the balance after four deposits to the nearest cent.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The half-yearly interest rate is $4\%\div2=2\%$. Let $V_n$ be the balance immediately after the $n$th deposit.

$V_0=0,\qquad V_n=V_{n-1}(1.02)+900$.

Apply the relation to each previous balance, retaining full precision.

$\begin{align*}V_1&=0(1.02)+900\\&=900\\V_2&=900(1.02)+900\\&=1818\\V_3&=1818(1.02)+900\\&=2754.36\\V_4&=2754.36(1.02)+900\\&=3709.4472\\&\approx\$3709.45\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text:
A loan is modelled by $V_n=V_{n-1}(1.02)-80$, where $V_0=5000$ and $V_n$ is the balance immediately after the $n$th monthly repayment.

Find the balance after three repayments, to the nearest cent, and explain why the debt increases despite regular repayments.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Use the previous balance to calculate each new balance.

$\begin{align*}V_1&=5000(1.02)-80\\&=5020\\V_2&=5020(1.02)-80\\&=5040.40\\V_3&=5040.40(1.02)-80\\&=5061.208\\&\approx\$5061.21\end{align*}$

The first month's interest is $5000\times0.02=\$100$. The $\$80$ repayment is less than the interest charged, so the debt increases. As the balance grows, the monthly interest also increases.

foundation.question_text:
An investment account starts with $\$0$.
Deposits of $\$3000$ are made at the end of each year at $6\%$ p.a. compounded annually.
Complete the table to find the balance at the end of Year $3$.
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Year} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (6\%) & \text{Deposit} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$0 & \$0 & \$3000 & \$3000 \\ 2 & \$3000 & \$180 & \$3000 & \$6180 \\ 3 & \$6180 & \text{---} & \$3000 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

A personal loan of $\$4000$ incurs interest at $1\%$ per month ($12\%$ p.a.), with monthly repayments of $\$600$ made at the end of each month.
Complete the table to find the balance owing after $2$ months.
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Month} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (1\%) & \text{Repayment} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$4000 & \$40 & \$600 & \$3440 \\ 2 & \$3440 & \text{---} & \$600 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

A savings annuity is modelled by the recurrence relation $V_{n} = V_{n-1} \times 1.05 + 800$, where $V_{0} = 0$.
Calculate the balance $V_{3}$ after $3$ payments.

A car loan is modelled by the recurrence relation $V_{n} = V_{n-1} \times 1.02 - 500$, where $V_{0} = 2000$.
Determine the balance $V_{2}$ after $2$ repayments.

An annuity investment account starts with a zero balance. Its table shows that after $4$ annual deposits of $\$1500$, the closing balance is $\$6820.65$.
Calculate the total interest earned over the $4$ years.

An account has $\$1000$ deposited at the end of each quarter at $2\%$ interest per quarter.
If the opening balance for Quarter $2$ is $\$1000$, find the interest earned in Quarter $2$ and the closing balance at the end of Quarter $2$.

development.question_text:
A loan of $\$10\,000$ charges interest at $6\%$ p.a. compounded monthly ($0.5\%$ per month), with monthly repayments of $\$800$.
Complete the table to find the closing balance at the end of Month $3$. Give the missing interest and closing balance to the nearest cent, retaining full precision until rounding each requested result.
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Month} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (0.5\%) & \text{Repayment} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$10\,000 & \$50.00 & \$800 & \$9250.00 \\ 2 & \$9250.00 & \$46.25 & \$800 & \$8496.25 \\ 3 & \$8496.25 & \text{---} & \$800 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

An investment annuity involves depositing $\$1200$ at the end of each half-year at $4\%$ p.a. compounded half-yearly ($r=0.02$).
Write the recurrence relation with $V_{0}=0$ and calculate the balance $V_{4}$ after $4$ half-years, to the nearest cent.

The table below shows the progress of a savings account over $3$ periods with equal deposits of $\$2000$ and fixed interest rate $r$.
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Period} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest} & \text{Deposit} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$0 & \$0 & \$2000 & \$2000 \\ 2 & \$2000 & \$100 & \$2000 & \$4100 \\ 3 & \$4100 & \text{---} & \$2000 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$
Find the periodic interest rate $r$ and the closing balance at the end of Period $3$.

A mortgage is modelled by $V_{n} = V_{n-1}(1.004) - 1500$, with $V_{0} = 180\,000$.
Calculate the balance owing $V_{3}$ after $3$ months, to the nearest cent.

For a $\$5000$ reducing-balance loan, repayments of $\$650$ are made at the end of each month for $4$ months, leaving a balance of $\$2542.80$.
Calculate the total interest charged over these $4$ months.

A borrower takes out a loan of $\$15\,000$ at $0.8\%$ monthly interest, making repayments of $\$900$ at the end of each month, after interest is charged.
What is the opening balance, interest, and closing balance for Month $2$?

mastery.question_text:
A spreadsheet records an annuity investment where an initial lump sum of $\$5000$ is invested at the start of Month $1$, and further deposits of $\$400$ are added at the end of each month.
The monthly interest rate is $0.6\%$.
Find the missing interest and closing balance at the end of Month $3$, to the nearest cent, retaining full precision until rounding each requested result.
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Month} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (0.6\%) & \text{Deposit} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$5000.00 & \$30.00 & \$400 & \$5430.00 \\ 2 & \$5430.00 & \$32.58 & \$400 & \$5862.58 \\ 3 & \$5862.58 & \text{---} & \$400 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

A debt of $\$8000$ is charged interest at $1.5\%$ per month, and repayments of $\$100$ per month are made.
Explain why the debt increases despite regular repayments, and evaluate the balance $V_{2}$ after $2$ months using $V_{n} = V_{n-1}(1.015) - 100$.
mastery.solution_text:
$\text{Initial monthly interest} = 8000 \times 0.015 = \$120$
Since the repayment of $\$100$ is less than the $\$120$ interest, the debt grows.
$V_{1} = 8000(1.015) - 100 = 8120 - 100 = 8020$
$V_{2} = 8020(1.015) - 100 = 8140.30 - 100$
$=\$8040.30$

mastery.question_text:
Over $3$ periods, an annuity investment with opening balance $\$0$ has deposits of $\$1000$ per period at $4\%$ per period.
The interest earned in each period is $\$0$, $\$40$, and $\$81.60$ respectively.
Verify the closing balance after Period $3$ and find the total interest earned.
